# Notation

This file defines the standard notations used across all atomic notes.

## Symbols

| Symbol | Description | Units | First Used In |
|--------|-------------|-------|---------------|
| `{VAULT}` | Kosmic vault root directory | path | — |
| `{TARGET}` | Vault Project folder name | path | — |
| `{PROJECT_ID}` | Immutable project identifier slug | slug | — |
| `{PROJECT_ID}-usage` | Usage Skill Projection name | slug | — |
| `{PROJECT_ID}-development` | Development Skill Projection name | slug | — |
| `working_state` | Checked-out state both pair members describe | — | — |

## Conventions

- Slugs are lowercase with hyphens; Project identifiers are immutable once assigned.
- Generated artifacts carry the "Generated by the Kosmic Projection CLI. Do not edit." marker and are never hand-edited.
- **Code state line**: when a log entry, note, or evidence record makes claims that depend on an exact code state, record it on one line:
  `Code state: {dir} ({host}) — git {head}, tree {tree|clean}, jj {change-id}`.
  `{dir}` is the repository path; `{host}` is `local` or `user@host` for remote machines; `tree` is the working-tree hash from the `provenance` command (`clean` if unmodified); `jj` is the colocated working-copy change id (omit git-only fields when not applicable).

## Notes

When adding new notation:
1. Check this file first to ensure consistency.
2. If notation already exists, use the same definition.
3. If new notation is needed, add it here before using it in notes.
4. If changing existing notation, update all related notes.
